summary: Completed comprehensive testing of Saint-Georges Academy enrollment email system. Backend APIs functional (93% success rate), email configuration verified, test emails sent successfully to verified account. Payment flow fully operational with Stripe integration. Admin email notifications fail due to unverified domain in Resend test environment (expected limitation).
